name: Bloxx
abilities: Touvlokinesis / block-body shapeshifting - rearranges his own blocks into walls, catapults, slides, domes, railway bridges and water reserves
Unlimited block generation and regeneration - regrows lost limbs and head, detaches or reabsorbs blocks at will
Bloxx-Lobbers - turns his hands into cannons that fire explosive blocks (also painful to step on)
Arm extension without adding blocks - crosses gaps and vaults over buildings
Size alteration - can grow several stories tall
Body encasing - traps foes or shields allies inside his blocks (protected Rook during atmospheric re-entry)
Sphere form - rolls at speed like Cannonbolt
Enhanced strength (punched through a Dimension 12 robot, ground-slam shock wave, carried Fistrick)
Enhanced durability (survived repeated shots, Negative Ultimate Humungousaur, being crushed by Ma Vreedle)
Space survivability, heat resistance and radiation immunity
weaknesses: Vulnerable to acidic substances, liquid or gaseous (Have I Got a Deal for You)
Blocks can be pulled apart or crushed by very strong opponents (beaten by Ma Vreedle, Negative Ultimate Humungousaur, Kundo)
summary: A gorilla-shaped Segmentasapien built from red, yellow and blue interlocking bricks that Ben can rearrange into almost anything - bridges, walls, domes or block-firing cannons.
traits: Organosilicon lifeform with segmented quasi-organic polymer skin
Blocks resemble LEGO bricks (a 240,000-brick Bloxx statue set a Guinness World Record in 2012)
Created by Dwayne McDuffie; working name 'Blox'
notableFeats: Saved Mr. Baumann's shop from destruction with Rook in his debut (The More Things Change: Part 1)
Became a bridge to save a runaway train, then contained the Screegit (Have I Got a Deal for You)
Stopped a Tetramand warship from attacking his team (Many Happy Returns)
Took Azmuth's brain back from Ultimate Albedo (For a Few Brains More)
Encased Rook to save him from burning up in Earth's atmosphere (Breakpoint)
Punched down Dimension 12 robots while de-aged to 11 (Arrested Development)

notableEpisodes: Have I Got a Deal for You
appearances.designNotes: Gorilla body of mostly red and yellow bricks with some blue, black seam lines and studs, stubby feet, oversized hands; Omnitrix symbol on chest.

image.label: OV

scoring.rationale: Versatility 7: he has been a bridge, catapult, wall, dome, cannon and life-support pod. Regeneration 7 (regrows limbs and head, reforms after being scattered) and defense 7 (encasing, domes) make him a great utility/tank pick, and he survives space and re-entry. Only moderate hitting power, and acid dissolves his blocks.

notes: Arrested Development use is wiki-labelled 'by 11-year-old Ben' - present-day Ben de-aged by Billy Billions' ray, not a flashback; recorded as ben-11-ov per the wiki label.
Despite debuting in the first episode, Derrick J. Wyatt states Bloxx (like the other new OV aliens) was never actually locked in the Omnitrix.
Season 8 uses in Stuck on You, Let's Do the Time War Again, Third Time's a Charm and Malgax Attacks were Skurd lending Bloxx-Lobbers to other aliens - not transformations.
Ben 23 counterpart: Build-A-Guy. Reboot has a separate Bloxx (excluded).
Video games (Omniverse, Omniverse 2), online/mobile games and comics not counted.
